## How it was tested

- [ ] A test that fails without this change
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] If it can affect speed or memory: numbers from `npm run bench:engine`, before and after
- [ ] Test data is invented text, with no real notes, people or companies
- [ ] The user guide or another doc is updated if behavior a user can see changed
